title: Harborline quarterly review
body:
Marcus: Thanks for joining, Dana. Usage is up 30 percent since June.
Dana: The product is working. My one big ask is payroll. We re-key hours into payroll every two weeks and it costs us two days.
Maya: We have payroll export on the roadmap. Sam, where are we?
Sam: CSV export works in staging. The API format is not started.
Dana: We need this before the January payroll cycle. That is a hard date for us.
Marcus: Could we pilot with one region first?
Dana: Yes. Start with the Gulf region.
Maya: Agreed, we pilot payroll integration with the Gulf region first.
Marcus: I will send you the integration scope by October 8.
Sam: I will confirm the export format with your IT team.
Dana: Good. Also our renewal comes up in Q1, so this matters.

_extraction.summary: Harborline's main ask is payroll integration before the January payroll cycle. The team agreed to pilot it with the Gulf region first.
_extraction.intent: Review the account and agree a payroll integration path

insights.text: Pilot payroll integration with Harborline's Gulf region first

title: Pinecrest Health intro call
body:
Luis: We run 14 hospitals. Nursing shifts change daily and payroll never matches.
Marcus: So the interest is payroll integration specifically?
Luis: Yes. If you can push approved hours into our payroll system we would move quickly.
Maya: We are piloting that with another customer this quarter.
Luis: Can we see a demo next week?
Marcus: I will set up a payroll integration demo for next week.
Maya: We should be clear the API format is not ready yet, only CSV.

_extraction.summary: Pinecrest Health is interested in payroll integration for nursing staff and asked for a demo next week.
_extraction.intent: Qualify a new customer and their payroll needs

insights.text: Set up a payroll integration demo for Pinecrest
Only CSV export is ready; the API format is not built

title: API migration runbook
body: How to move an endpoint between LLM providers. Steps: add the provider behind the abstraction, shadow traffic for 48 hours, compare quality on the golden set, switch, keep the old provider as fallback for two weeks. Open questions: who rotates provider keys, what is the rollback trigger, and who signs off on quality.

_extraction.summary: Runbook for moving an endpoint between LLM providers, with three open questions on key rotation, rollback trigger and quality sign-off.

insights.text: The migration runbook has no defined rollback trigger
